lab_table.hypothesis: Default-scale inclusion repeat: the Round-2 control recipe (default 0.6-1.4 inclusion, 30/10/10) had the highest mAP50 (0.6334) and best patches (0.780); the small-inclusion gain in inclusion AP50 (+0.036) was offset by the patches cost (-0.085). Repeating the default recipe in round 3 on the cumulative set should hold or extend the mAP50 lead. Confirmed if mAP50 >= 0.6334 with patches AP50 >= 0.75 and inclusion AP50 >= 0.45.

Inclusion-cap push: inclusion is still the worst class (AP50 0.493, low-tertile recall 0.288, 112 missed at ~33px) and small-scale 0.3-0.7 pastes are the proven lever for it; inclusion AP50 rose with every +30 small inclusions (0.329 -> 0.457 -> 0.493), so spending more of the 45 headroom (40 vs 30) should lift inclusion further, and the small reduction of patches/scratches to 5 each is tolerable since both sit near 0.70. Confirmed if inclusion AP50 > 0.50 and mAP50 beats the small-inclusion 30/10/10 control; if it loses, 30 is the sweet spot and allocation balance matters more than I thought.

Small-patches recovery: under small inclusion, patches AP50 dropped to 0.695 (vs 0.780 with default inclusion) because small inclusion pastes resemble small patches; missed patches are small (median 54.6px, low-tertile recall 0.578, n=90) and Round 1 showed 0.4-0.8x patches were not harmful to patches (0.785 vs 0.765 control). Adding small patches should sharpen the patch/inclusion boundary and recover the dip while keeping the inclusion gain. Confirmed if patches AP50 > 0.74, inclusion AP50 > 0.48, and mAP50 > 0.6334; if patches stay < 0.72, small patches do not fix the interaction and the default recipe (A) is the safer final bet.

lesson: Default-scale inclusion (0.6-1.4) at 30/10/10 is the best recipe: it extended mAP50 to 0.6614 with the best scratches (0.757) and competitive inclusion (0.490), beating the small-inclusion variant. Pushing inclusion to 40 (candidate 2) backfired — inclusion AP50 fell to 0.410 and mAP50 dropped, so 30 is the sweet spot and 5/5 starvation of the other classes is not worth it. Small patches (candidate 3) recovered patches (0.800) but cost inclusion and scratches, a net loss; the default recipe is the final bet.
